A '''Cooling Module''' was a component in some [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. On the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]], the Cooling Module was located above the grip, between the [[gas chamber]] and the [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]].<ref name="EGWT" />
